description:
World Cup tested geometry meets high end alloy reliability. The new AIR 9 in hydroformed alloy benefits from the same decade of refinement and testing as does the entire Air 9 Family, while representing NIner’s most economical racing option. Riders benefit from years of hardtail experience with the unique ride quality of a high end alloy frame.
HYDROFORMED ALLOY
This version of our alloy hardtail integrates hydroformed tubing throughout. More than a cosmetic feature, hydroforming allows us to shape tubes, control wall thickness and optimize strength and stiffness in key areas. This customization creates perfectly tuned frames with precise ride characteristics – in other words, ideal ride feel. You will find hydroforming in the toptube, downtube, headtube, chainstays and seatstays.
Bottom line? A light, stiff frame with better ride feel and improved steering results in better power transfer and an overall efficiency improvement. In other words, the updated Air 9 will win more races.
DESIGN
Niner is commited to producing high-end alloy frames. The shapes of our Air 9 hydroformed frame are heavily influenced by our long history in carbon fiber race frame design – in particular by our experience in building light, strong hardtails with velvet-smooth off road ride-quality. The rigid sides of our signature downtube and top tube shapes maximize torsional stiffness, with buttery smooth ride quality achieved via the flat sections on each tube, which act like leaf springs.
NINER’S SAFETY PROGRAM
Our robust R&D program—computer modeling, physical prototype testing (both in-house and at independent testing facilities), and hours of ride testing under highly skilled and abusive test riders leave us confident that the AIR 9 is going to exceed your safety expectations. We maintain that our design rivals the best in the bike industry, meeting EN (European) standards for safety, even at longer fork travel lengths).
PERFORMANCE GEOMETRY
Niner’s hardtail racing geometry is one that has has garnered multiple national championships via the original Scandium Air 9, a Singlespeed World Championship via the Air 9 Carbon and World Cup podiums and national series race wins via the Air 9 RDO. Though time tested, Niner’s geometry has not remained stagnant - it has seen continual refinements to account for new technologies and to accommodate new fork travel lengths, while still meeting EN Safety standards for increased forces. The new Air 9 can safely accommodate forks with up to 120mm of travel, while maintaining the stable, precise steering and handling that lets you relax, be confident and focus on being fast.
The new Air 9 is offered in the full range of Niner size options, from XS through XL.
PRESS FIT 30 BOTTOM BRACKET
The AIR 9 utilizes the Press Fit 30 standard, the larger shell mates beautifully with the larger aluminum downtube for elegant looks and efficient power transfer so crucial in a race bike. Additionally, this allows for the use of the stiffer, lighter crankset designs that fit the PF30 standard.
142 x 12 REAR DROP OUT WITH MAXLE
Don’t waste your training - a 142x12 spacing combined with a Maxle maximizes an athlete’s power transfer via rear triangle stiffness. Maintenance is easier, too - the Air 9 shares same Niner derailleur hanger as many Niner models for easy replaceabilty via your local dealer.
FORK
The AIR 9 frame can be paired with any standard taper steer tube cross country fork from 100-120mm in travel. For the ultimate in light weight short track racing machines, pair it with Niner’s RDO Carbon fork. Niner’s award winning rigid carbon forks have set the standard for weight, ride quality and safety for years – we’ve used this experience to create an race fork with the off-road ride quality racers want. Fork stiffness prevents energy robbing brake rub and the thru axle plus taper steer tube combo ensures precision cornering on the toughest of courses.
DETAILS
The AIR 9 frame details benefit from the same iterative process that drives the overall design - the headbage is sleeker and lighter, the cable routing is direct and easy for team mechanics (or privateers) to maintain. Each of these small changes adds up to a huge difference for a rider that wants to keep focus away from maintenance and on the competition.
High end Niner hydroformed alloy
With Niner’s RDO Carbon fork, is a light integrated off road racing system
Niner’s World Cup tested racing geometry
